clips.title: The story
paras: The Train Depot is a subterranean transit hub located just below the surface entrances of Gnomeregan in Dun Morogh. Once a bustling center of gnomish locomotion, it now swarms with hostile leper gnomes and invading troggs.

Situated at the bottom of the grand elevator leading down from Dun Morogh, the Train Depot once served as the primary nexus for rail transport across the subterranean marvel of Gnomeregan. Today, the platforms and railbeds lie in shambles. The fallout that irradiated the city transformed its remaining workers into crazed leper gnomes, while subterranean troggs have overrun the tracks. Explorers descending into the ruined city must navigate this staging ground to reach deeper sectors such as Clockwerk Run, the Loading Room, and the inner engineering facilities.
